title: Cusanuswerk: Undergraduate and Postgraduate Fellowships
summary: Fellowships for particularly gifted Catholic students and doctoral candidates from all disciplines, offering financial support modeled after BAföG or a monthly doctoral stipend, alongside interdisciplinary training.

institutions.notes: German state or state-recognised higher-education institution mentioned for entrance qualifications and doctoral admissions.

nationality.notes: German citizenship or BAföG § 8, 1-3 eligibility for students; foreign nationals admitted to a doctoral programme in Germany or applicants from developing/emerging countries in Africa, Asia, Near/Middle East, Latin America, Eastern Europe unable to apply to KAAD for doctoral candidates.

residence.notes: For doctoral candidates, must be admitted to a doctoral programme at a German state or state-recognised higher education institution.

mandatory.text: Membership in the catholic Church (or non-united orthodox/oriental-orthodox after individual assessment)
At least C1 level (CEFR) language skills in German
Excellent academic merit and interest in interdisciplinary approach
For students: German citizenship or BAföG § 8, 1-3 eligibility, plus Abitur or higher-education entrance qualification for German higher education

For doctoral candidates: foreign nationals admitted to a doctoral programme at a German state or state-recognised higher education institution, or applicants from a developing or emerging country unable to apply to KAAD

funding.description: Students receive a monthly BAföG-modelled grant based on income/assets plus a standard study cost allowance of 300 EUR per month. Doctoral candidates receive 1,650 EUR per month plus a research cost allowance of 100 EUR, plus health care, child, and family allowances if required.
funding.duration: For doctoral candidates a maximum of 3 years and 6 months (extendable to 4 years for illness/child care); duration for students is individually agreed.

application_rounds.notes: Updated application deadlines may be found on the provider's website.

steps.text: Check application forms and further information on the provider website.
